theater: 高加索汗國、埃里溫與亞塞拜疆

battle.name: 俄國-波斯戰爭 (1826年-1828年)
battle.theater: 高加索汗國、埃里溫與亞塞拜疆
battle.brief: 一八二六至二八年俄波戰爭：波斯越過阿拉斯河攻入北高加索汗國，卻被帕斯凱維奇以縱隊反攻逐出，葉莉薩維特波爾一役中軍崩潰，埃里溫與阿哈爾齊赫相繼淪陷，終以土庫曼恰伊條約割地賠款。卡面輪發槍是這條血脈上最早期後膛手槍，其「機關自足、只給軍官衛兵」的位置正說明本役裝備差距。

kit.name: 輪發槍
kit.history: 最早的後膛手槍。機械太貴，只給火槍隊的軍官與衛兵。

countries: 交戰的兩方是卡雅王朝的波斯與俄羅斯帝國。波斯方面以法特阿里沙赫為國主，王儲阿拔斯·米爾扎統率大軍，主力是沙赫的中央常備軍（阿拔斯米爾扎的「阿什克爾」新軍）、卡雅部族（奇茲勒巴什、庫爾德、魯爾、亞塞拜疆土庫曼）徵調的部族騎兵與步兵，以及希拉萬、卡爾巴赫、巴庫、沙基、捷爾賓特等受波斯宗主保護的高加索汗國守軍；火藥、槍械與兵站由德黑蘭中央政府籌措，軍備整頓由維齊爾阿米爾卡比爾主持。俄國方面是亞歷山大一世皇帝的高加索方面軍與裏海艦隊：步兵團、哥薩克騎兵、屬國軍隊，以及受俄方指揮的高加索線沿線要塞（第比利斯、埃里溫方向的分段堡壘），指揮體系以沙皇—財政大臣—陸軍總司令—外省總督（高加索總督帕斯凱維奇）逐級下達，後勤靠第比利斯與西歐輸入的彈藥、馬匹和糧秣。戰爭在卡雅史觀中屬於「波斯大戰爭」系列的一環，接在一八〇四至一八一三年第一次俄波戰爭與一八一三年古利斯坦條約之後，是卡雅王朝企圖收復北高加索的一次總攻。
countriesEn: The two belligerents were Qajar Iran and the Russian Empire. On the Persian side sat Shah Fath-Ali as monarch, with the crown prince Abbas Mirza commanding the field armies; the main strength was the shah's central standing army (the reformed ashkar troops of Abbas Mirza), tribal cavalry and infantry mustered among the Qizilbash, Kurds, Lurs and Transcaucasian Turcomans, and the garrisons of the Persian-protected Caucasian khanates of Shirvan, Karabakh, Baku, Shaki and Derbent; powder, small arms and commissariat were supplied by the central government in Tehran, and the reorganisation of the war material was directed by the grand vizier Amir Kabir. On the Russian side stood Alexander I's Caucasus Corps and the Caspian Fleet: infantry regiments, Cossack cavalry, auxiliary units, and the chain of fortresses along the Caucasian Line (the detached redoubts in the Tiflis and Erivan directions). The Russian command system ran from the tsar and the minister of finance down through the commander-in-chief to the viceroy of the Caucasus, Paskevich; the rear was fed by Tiflis and by munitions, horses and provisions imported from Western Europe. In Qajar historiography this war belongs to the series of the great Persian wars, following the first Russo-Persian War of 1804-1813 and the Treaty of Gulistan of 1813; it was the Qajar state's attempt to recover the North Caucasus in one grand offensive.
people: 關鍵人物是法特阿里沙赫與王儲阿拔斯·米爾扎。沙赫在古利斯坦條約後一直拒絕接受俄方的劃界方案，保留汗國作為緩衝；他指派受命出使的米哈伊爾·莫爾科夫（Georgy Morkovin）在德黑蘭談判，交涉破裂後改採拖延加備戰的策略。真正在前線的是王儲阿拔斯·米爾扎，他以卡爾巴赫為基地，集結部族與中央軍，於一八二六年夏季進攻高加索各汗國；他的兄弟亞布杜拉赫曼汗（Abdol-Bakh Khan）是實際的統兵者。俄方主帥是伊萬·帕斯凱維奇（Ivan Paskevich），他在高加索總督任內設計了一整套戰役：先以小股部隊固守邊境據點與遊騎反制，待波斯主力深入後集中兩軍主力，於一八二七年六月在葉莉薩維特波爾（Jelisavetpol，今阿塞拜疆的加尼加）外與波斯軍主力會戰；此役俄軍大勝後，他乘勢圍困埃里溫，逼降哈桑汗（Hasan Khan），再取阿哈爾齊赫，兵鋒直指捷爾賓特與大不里士方向。維齊爾阿米爾卡比爾（Amir Kabir）在德黑蘭主持軍備與外交，一手推動對英國購械、招募歐洲教官與自鑄火炮，是波方最關鍵的技術與行政角色；英國駐波斯公使約翰·麥克唐納·金尼爾（John Macdonald Kinneir）居間斡旋，促成停戰與條約談判。
peopleEn: The key figures were Shah Fath-Ali and the crown prince Abbas Mirza. After the Treaty of Gulistan the shah had consistently refused to accept the Russian demarcation scheme, keeping the khanates as a buffer; he sent the envoy Georgy Morkovin to negotiate in Tehran, and when talks broke down he adopted a policy of delay and of preparing for war. The man on the ground was the crown prince Abbas Mirza, who used Karabakh as his base, gathered tribal and central troops, and in the summer of 1826 attacked the Caucasian khanates; his brother Abdol-Bakh Khan commanded the actual formations in the field. The Russian commander was Ivan Paskevich, who as viceroy of the Caucasus designed the whole campaign: first securing the frontier posts and covering the border with raids, then, once the Persian main army had penetrated deeply, concentrating his two armies and meeting the Persian main force in June 1827 at Jelisavetpol (modern Gandja in Azerbaijan); after that decisive Russian victory he besieged Erivan, forced Hasan Khan to surrender, took Akhaltsikhe, and drove straight towards Derbent and the approaches of Tabriz. The grand vizier Amir Kabir directed armament and diplomacy in Tehran, pushing purchases of British weapons, the hiring of European instructors and the domestic casting of cannon; he was the pivotal technical and administrative figure on the Persian side. The British ambassador to Persia, John Macdonald Kinneir, mediated between the two governments and helped bring about the armistice and the peace negotiations.
kits: 卡面這件輪發槍（Wheellock pistol）是十六世紀初的後膛手槍，靠發條機構的棘輪與掣子擊發、機匣密閉自足，不需要另外攜帶引火藥粉；正因機械複雜、造價高昂，它在十六世紀只配給火槍隊與衛兵的軍官，是「後膛技術＋軍官階級專用」的典型器物。到十九世紀二十年代，這條血脈早已傳到第三代：俄軍與波斯軍的步槍手槍都已換成燧發（flintlock）式，1820年代後期再換上擊燧帽（percussion cap）式手槍；然而輪發槍確立的兩條規則卻完整保留下來——第一，後膛裝填，自槍口塞入的火藥必須壓實，可節省珍貴的黑火藥並加快射速；第二，機構自足，不需火繩或火藥盤上的散藥，據此發展出的擊燧帽最終把「散藥點火」徹底淘汰，令本戰爭後十數年內就出現了後膛擊發、銅殼裝藥的現代手槍。本役實際用過的裝備：俄軍步兵用燧發步槍，哥薩克用騎槍，炮兵用可以壓膛的攻城炮與野炮，攻城時把重炮拉到堡壘外作封鎖射擊；波斯軍中央師與汗國守備大量使用老式火繩槍與燧發槍混編，部族兵幾乎只有長矛、標槍、彎刀與弓箭，阿拔斯·米爾扎的新軍才逐步換上英國進口的燧發槍。攻城器材方面，葉莉薩維特波爾一役俄軍集中了野炮群與騎兵，埃里溫圍城則用重炮與封鎖線對付城牆與碉堡；阿哈爾齊赫的攻守依賴高處砲台與城門前的斜射火力。裏海艦隊的艦載炮則用於裏海東岸的封鎖與登岸支援。卡面武器所屬的「後膛手槍」類別在這場戰役裡沒有出現在戰鬥序列上，但它的制度位置——槍口朝前、由軍官與衛兵隨身攜帶的副武器——被後膛擊發手槍完整繼承。
kitsEn: The wheellock pistol on the card is an early sixteenth-century breech-loading handgun, fired by a spring-driven ratchet and sear inside a self-contained, sealed mechanism, requiring no separate priming powder to be carried. Precisely because the mechanism was complex and costly, it was issued only to officers of the arquebusiers and the guards in the sixteenth century, and it is the classic example of 'breech-loading technology plus officer-only issue'. By the 1820s that line of descent had already run to its third generation: the pistols of both the Russian and Persian infantry had been replaced by flintlocks, and in the late 1820s by percussion-cap pistols. Yet the two rules the wheelock established survived intact. First, breech loading: the charge rammed down the barrel saved scarce black powder and sped up the rate of fire. Second, a self-contained mechanism needing no loose priming powder on a pan, which led in the end to the percussion cap and the total abandonment of loose-powder ignition, and within a few decades of this war to the modern breech-loading, brass-cased pistol. The equipment actually used in this campaign: Russian infantry carried flintlock muskets, Cossacks their carbines, the artillery siege and field guns capable of being rammed, and heavy guns were brought up against the fortresses to deliver blockade fire; the Persian central divisions and the khanate garrisons mixed old matchlocks with flintlocks, while the tribal levies had almost nothing beyond spears, javelins, sabres and bows, and only Abbas Mirza's reformed troops gradually took up flintlock muskets bought from Britain. For siege material, the Russians massed field guns and cavalry at Jelisavetpol and used heavy batteries and a blockade line against the walls and bastions of Erivan; the fighting at Akhaltsikhe turned on high batteries and enfilading fire from before the gates. The naval guns of the Caspian Fleet were used to blockade the eastern littoral and to support the landings. The breech-loading pistol class represented on the card never appears in the order of battle here, but its institutional position — a side weapon carried muzzle-forward by officers and guards — was inherited in full by the percussion pistol.
tactics: 波斯的戰術主軸是快速機動與游擊戰。一八二六年七月，阿拔斯·米爾扎以卡爾巴赫、希拉萬兩汗國的守軍為前鋒，騎兵先行渡過阿拉斯河，步兵主力隨後跟進，遠程的中央軍尚未集中便已發動進攻；俄方邊境守備分散、堡壘之間缺乏聯繫，汗國守軍在游騎襲擊與內應配合下相繼易手，舒沙、卡爾巴赫與希拉萬的城邑相繼落入波斯之手。與此同時，波斯騎兵依游牧部族的傳統不與俄軍正面決戰，而是以大縱隊遷徙包抄、襲擊俄軍糧道與冬營，逼俄軍分兵守備，切斷第比利斯方向通往埃里溫的補給線。俄軍的戰術則是典型的帝國式攻勢：帕斯凱維奇以哥薩克與輕騎前出偵察，不與波斯騎兵糾纏，而是把主力集結在高加索線縱深，等波斯軍深入越過阿拉斯河、在葉莉薩維特波爾一帶展開成密集縱隊陣形時，以集中的野炮群先制壓——波斯方面火炮數量雖多，但多為老舊的輕型野炮，射程與射速不及俄軍新式火炮——再由步兵縱隊在炮火掩護下反覆衝擊，終於在其左翼突破中軍，迫其崩潰。埃里溫圍城則是另一種樣式：先以封鎖線切斷城與鄉野的聯繫，步步為營地接近城牆，用重炮對準城內密集的居民區與巴扎反覆轟擊，同時封鎖城郊交通，最後以圍城炮兵與突擊步兵配合逼降哈桑汗。阿哈爾齊赫的攻略同樣是圍城加炮擊，結果是城門開啟。整場戰爭的勝負手是三樣東西：炮兵、攻城技術、以及補給線。
tacticsEn: The Persian tactical axis was rapid manoeuvre and guerrilla war. In July 1826 Abbas Mirza used the garrisons of the khanates of Karabakh and Shirvan as his spearhead: the cavalry crossed the Araxes first, the infantry main body followed, and the offensive was launched before the distant central army had even concentrated. The Russian frontier was thinly held, the forts had little mutual support, and the khanate garrisons changed hands one after another through cavalry raids and collusion from within; the towns of Shusha, Karabakh and Shirvan fell to the Persians in turn. At the same time, the Persian cavalry, faithful to the tradition of the nomadic tribes, refused to meet the Russians in open battle, but used wide columns to outflank, harry the Russian supply lines and winter quarters, and force the Russians to detach troops to hold the roads, cutting the supply route from Tiflis towards Erivan. The Russian tactics were those of an imperial offensive: Paskevich pushed Cossacks and light cavalry forward on reconnaissance, refused to be drawn into a cavalry duel, and concentrated his main force in depth behind the Caucasian Line, waiting until the Persian army had crossed the Araxes and deployed in dense columnar order around Jelisavetpol. There he opened with a concentrated mass of field guns. The Persians had more guns in number, but they were mostly old light pieces whose range and rate of fire could not match the newer Russian artillery. Russian infantry columns then assaulted again under cover of that fire, and the Persian centre was finally broken on its left flank, collapsing the line. The siege of Erivan was a different pattern: a blockade line cut the town off from the countryside, the besiegers advanced by covered steps until they were close enough to the walls, and heavy guns were turned on the dense built-up quarters and the bazaar inside the town with repeated bombardment, while the roads around the fortress were sealed, ending with a combination of siege artillery and assault infantry that forced Hasan Khan to surrender. Akhaltsikhe was likewise taken by siege and bombardment, and its gates opened. Three things decided this war: artillery, siege technique, and the supply line.
data: 可核對的數字散見於俄方與波斯方不同的記錄，數量級如下。俄國方面：一八二六年夏季在亞塞拜疆方向的作戰部隊，參戰各方記錄約在數千人至一萬餘人之間；葉莉薩維特波爾會戰前，帕斯凱維奇集中可用兵力約一萬人上下，配野炮數十門。波斯方面：一八二六年攻勢的總兵力在不同來源介於數萬之間，核心是阿拔斯·米爾扎自卡爾巴赫、希拉萬集結的部族騎兵與中央軍，另有各汗國守軍；一般記載該次會戰波斯軍列陣人數約三萬、火炮約六十門。埃里溫守軍約四千人上下，另有城內民兵與居民組織的守備，攻城方投入野炮與重型攻城炮各若干。戰役推進速度：自一八二六年七月開戰，至一八二七年六月葉莉薩維特波爾會戰，約十一個月；埃里溫於同年七月陷落，阿哈爾齊赫同年秋失守，戰事至一八二八年二月結束，前後約十九個月。條約賠款與割地：土庫曼恰伊條約（1828年2月21日）規定波斯割讓埃里溫、納希切萬、舒沙、卡爾巴赫、希拉萬等區，賠付白銀三百萬盧布，並允許俄國在波斯境內取得鹽礦等經濟權益。戰役中的傷亡與損耗：葉莉薩維特波爾一役波斯軍死傷與被俘合計在數千人量級，俄軍損失相對有限；攻城戰中波斯守軍被俘約數千人，俄軍亦有大約數千名傷兵。
dataEn: The verifiable figures are scattered across Russian and Persian accounts, and their orders of magnitude are as follows. On the Russian side: in the Transcaucasian theatre in the summer of 1826 the field forces actually engaged are recorded at several thousand up to somewhat over ten thousand; before the battle of Jelisavetpol Paskevich concentrated roughly ten thousand men with some dozens of field guns. On the Persian side: the total strength of the 1826 offensive is given in different sources as amounting to tens of thousands, the core being the tribal cavalry and central troops mustered by Abbas Mirza in Karabakh and Shirvan, together with the garrisons of the khanates; the usual figure for the army deployed at Jelisavetpol is about thirty thousand men with about sixty guns. The garrison of Erivan numbered around four thousand, supplemented by a town militia and the organised defenders of the inhabitants, while the besiegers brought up field guns and heavy siege pieces. Rate of progress: from the opening of the offensive in July 1826 to the battle of Jelisavetpol in June 1827 is about eleven months; Erivan fell in July of that year and Akhaltsikhe was lost in the autumn, and the fighting ended in February 1828, about nineteen months in all. Indemnity and cessions: the Treaty of Turkmenchay of 21 February 1828 required Persia to cede Erivan, Nakhichevan, Shusha, Karabakh, Shirvan and other districts, to pay three million roubles in silver, and to concede economic privileges to Russia, including the salt mines. Losses: at Jelisavetpol the Persian dead, wounded and captured together are on the order of several thousand, while Russian losses were comparatively modest; in the siege operations some several thousand Persian defenders were taken prisoner, and Russia also counted several thousand wounded of its own.
cause: 直接起因是古利斯坦條約留下的邊界糾紛。一八一三年俄波訂立古利斯坦條約，割讓達吉斯坦、喬治亞與北高加索多個汗國，但條約並未完成實地劃界，條約文本與當地實際控制線之間存在大片爭議地帶，波斯朝廷拒絕讓俄方測量隊進入汗國，談判拖延多年。一八二五年至一八二六年間，莫爾科夫在德黑蘭的使節任務失敗，回到聖彼得堡的沙皇朝廷轉而準備用實力解決；俄方在邊境增修要塞、派兵巡邏，與當地卡雅部族的遊騎衝突不斷，波斯內廷則乘機在汗國收購人心、煽動反俄。一八二六年夏季，莫爾科夫在德黑蘭的談判面臨破裂，沙赫轉而向俄方提出歸還越界軍隊、追回被擄俄軍人等要求，此舉被視為對沙皇權威的冒犯，俄國中止談判並下達動員令，同時波斯朝廷已先一步下令阿拔斯·米爾扎進攻汗國，企圖在俄軍集結前造成既成事實。深層次看，這場衝突亦是卡雅王朝內部權力變化的產物：阿拔斯·米爾扎及阿米爾卡比爾這一派主張以新式軍隊收復失地與改革軍制，保守派與沙赫本人則對此舉抱持矛盾態度，而歐洲列強（尤其英國）在波斯海岸與裏海一帶的商路利益，亦使衝突牽涉到外交層面。
causeEn: The proximate cause lay in the frontier dispute left over by the Treaty of Gulistan. In 1813 Russia and Persia concluded that treaty, ceding Daghestan, Georgia and a number of the North Caucasian khanates, but the demarcation was never carried out on the ground, and wide disputed tracts remained between the letter of the treaty and the actual line of control; the Persian court refused to allow Russian survey parties into the khanates, and the negotiations dragged on for years. Between 1825 and 1826 Morkovin's mission in Tehran failed, and the court at St Petersburg, on receiving his report, prepared to settle the matter by force: frontier redoubts were reinforced, patrols were increased, and clashes with the mounted parties of the Qizilbash and other Caucasian tribes became constant, while the Persian government used the opportunity to court opinion in the khanates and stir up anti-Russian feeling. In the summer of 1826, with Morkovin's negotiations in Tehran near collapse, the shah made demands on Russia, including the withdrawal of Persian troops that had crossed the line and the return of Russian prisoners taken earlier; this was taken as an affront to tsarist authority. Russia broke off the talks and ordered mobilisation, and the Persian court, moving first, ordered Abbas Mirza to attack the khanates in the hope of creating accomplished facts before the Russian forces could concentrate. At a deeper level the conflict was also the product of a shift inside the Qajar state: the party of Abbas Mirza and Amir Kabir favoured recovering the lost territories with a modernised army and reforming the war material, while the conservative elements and the shah himself were divided over the project; and the commercial interests of the European powers, Britain above all, along the Persian coast and the Caspian, drew the dispute into the diplomatic sphere as well.
impact: 這場戰爭的結果改寫了波斯的版圖與國運，也改寫了俄國在南高加索的戰略位置。割地之後，埃里溫、納希切萬、舒沙、卡爾巴赫與巴庫一帶脫離波斯，亞塞拜疆北岸與亞美尼亞大部歸入俄國，波斯在南高加索的勢力自此退到阿拉斯河以南；俄國則把邊界從達吉斯坦山區推前到亞塞拜疆平原，取得從裏海到大不里士的進攻跳板，兩軍之間只剩一道靠高山與要塞維繫的邊界線，此後數十年高加索戰事不斷，正是這條邊界線引發。對波斯內部而言，戰敗直接重創阿米爾卡比爾主持的軍備改革路線：自鑄火炮、購置英國火槍與建立新軍的計畫因戰爭失敗而受挫，卻也促使朝廷在戰後加速推動歐式軍制，籌建德黑蘭的兵工廠與火藥廠，並在外交上向俄國索償。另一重影響是英國角色的變化——金尼爾以中間人身份促成了對波斯不利的條約，卻也令英國在高加索問題上被指偏袒俄國，此種怨恨最終在十九世紀中葉「大遊戲」時代轉化為英俄在亞洲的角力。軍事技術上，本役是後膛火器與前膛火器交替的見證：戰場上新式燧發步槍、野炮與攻城技術決定勝負，火繩槍與部族長矛仍大量服役；而卡面所屬的後膛手槍傳統，正是從此一役的裝備差距中逐漸被後膛裝填、擊燧發火這條新路線取代的起點。
impactEn: The outcome of this war redrew the map and the fortunes of Persia, and reshaped Russia's strategic position in the Transcaucasus. With the cessions, Erivan, Nakhichevan, Shusha, Karabakh and the neighbourhood of Baku left Persia, most of northern Azerbaijan and the greater part of Armenia passed to Russia, and Persian power in the South Caucasus withdrew behind the Araxes. Russia pushed its frontier forward from the mountains of Daghestan onto the plains of Azerbaijan and gained a springboard for an advance on Tabriz, with only a frontier line held together by mountains and fortresses separating the two armies — and the wars of the Caucasus over the following decades were born of that line. Inside Persia the defeat struck directly at the military-reform line pursued by Amir Kabir: the plans for casting cannon at home, buying British muskets and raising a new army were checked by the war, yet the court accelerated European-style reorganisation afterwards, building the arsenal and powder works in Tehran and pressing claims for compensation from Russia. A second effect was the change in Britain's role: Kinneir's mediation produced a treaty unfavourable to Persia, but also left Britain accused of favouring Russia on the Caucasian question, and that resentment later hardened into the Anglo-Russian rivalry over Asia in the mid-nineteenth century. In military technology the campaign is a witness to the handover between breech-loading and muzzle-loading weapons: new flintlock muskets, field guns and siege technique decided the fighting, while matchlocks and tribal spears remained in wide service; and the breech-loading pistol tradition to which the card belongs was the line that, out of the equipment gap visible in this war, was gradually displaced by the new path of breech loading with percussion ignition.
result: 結果是俄國全勝，波斯割地賠款而保國。1828年2月21日，雙方在裏海東岸的土庫曼恰伊村簽訂條約：波斯割讓埃里溫、納希切萬、舒沙、卡爾巴赫、希拉萬與巴庫等廣大區域，賠付白銀三百萬盧布，割讓的部分高加索汗國建制被撤銷，改為俄國的省份與要塞體系；條約同時賦予俄國在波斯的鹽礦開採權與通商優惠。波斯保住大不里士與國土核心，但失去北高加索的兵源、礦產與屏障，國力大損，軍隊改革被迫在財政困窘下重啟。此後數年，波斯一面在阿米爾卡比爾主持下整軍備（自鑄火炮、建立兵工廠、招募歐洲教官、購置英國步槍），一面在外交上試圖以英國與奧斯曼牽制俄國，試圖在下一輪衝突中扳回一城；而俄國則在亞塞拜疆獲得基地，把目光轉向鄂圖曼方向，一八二八年俄土戰爭隨即開打。戰役本身的戰術結論則相當明確：改編與技術落後的一方，即使有再多的部族騎兵與火炮數量，也難以抵擋集結的近代步兵縱隊、集中的野炮群與技術純熟的圍城工程——這正是俄國在十九世紀上半葉得以不斷向亞洲內陸推進的深層原因。
resultEn: The result was a complete Russian victory, with Persia buying off defeat by ceding territory and paying an indemnity. On 21 February 1828 the two powers signed a treaty at the village of Turkmenchay on the eastern Caspian littoral: Persia ceded Erivan, Nakhichevan, Shusha, Karabakh, Shirvan and the neighbourhood of Baku, paid three million roubles in silver, and the khanates included in the cession had their institutions abolished and replaced by Russian provinces and fortresses; the treaty also secured Russia the right to work the salt mines and commercial privileges in Persia. Persia kept Tabriz and the core of the kingdom, but lost the manpower, the mineral wealth and the buffer of the North Caucasus, its strength was badly shaken, and the reform of its army had to be restarted under severe financial constraint. In the years that followed, Persia tried to rearm itself under Amir Kabir — casting cannon at home, founding an arsenal, hiring European instructors and buying British muskets — while simultaneously seeking to hold Russia in check through Britain and the Ottoman Empire in the hope of recovering ground in the next round of conflict. Russia, for its part, now possessed a base in Azerbaijan and turned its eyes towards the Ottoman frontier, and the Russo-Turkish War of 1828 broke out almost at once. The tactical conclusion of the campaign was equally clear: the side that lagged in organisation and technique could not, for all its tribal cavalry and its greater number of guns, withstand concentrated modern infantry columns, massed field artillery and skilled siege engineering — and that is the deeper reason why Russia was able to keep pushing into the interior of Asia through the first half of the nineteenth century.
